answer: Use the **Meta Picker**. Pages tagged with a tag starting with `#meta` are hidden from the page picker. To switch from inside the page picker, type `^` when the filter phrase is empty. You can also step through the segments with `Tab` and `Shift-Tab`.

Page Picker.md:26:> Any page tagged with a tag starting with `#meta`, even though technically regular pages, will **not** appear in the page picker. To navigate to them, use the [[Meta Picker]] instead.

Page.md:15:* **[[Meta Page|Meta pages]]:** these are pages that contain implementation details _about_ your space (they are “meta”). A lot of these will be part of [[Library]]. You navigate between these using the [[Meta Picker]].
Meta Page.md:14:Meta pages at a technical level are [[Page]] like any other, the only technical difference is that they are tagged with any tag _starting_ with `#meta`. This is picked up by the [[Page Picker]] and [[Meta Picker]].
Meta Picker.md:5:The meta picker is used to navigate between [[Meta Page]]. Functionally it’s equivalent to the [[Page Picker]] except that it only shows pages tagged with a `meta` tag prefix.
